##: rBrowser in the Scoop bucket degoya/scoop-rbrowser (RB-090-13). Rendered from packaging/scoop/rbrowser.json.in in degoya/rBrowser by scripts/package-managers.sh and replaced by the release workflow with every release: change the template, not this file. No persist: settings and profiles live in the user's %APPDATA%\rBrowser and %LOCALAPPDATA%\rBrowser, not beside the program. post_install writes the install-kind marker that rb-update reads, so the app leaves updating to Scoop.
description: Development browser that shows every breakpoint of a site at once
notes: rBrowser installed through Scoop does not replace itself: update it with `scoop update rbrowser`.
